title: Show the state, not an action

do.text: Label the toggle with what it turns on ("Bold"), so its pressed state reads as that thing being on.

dont.text: Don't label it with a verb ("Make bold"): pressed, it reads as an instruction that was already followed.

do.text: Use a toggle for an option on the content in front of people.

dont.text: Don't put a toggle in a settings list: a [Switch](/components/switch) says on and off more plainly there.
